title: A shared research workflow continued transferring workspace files between three fictional providers after its access permissions were meant to expire
summary: In this fictional scenario, a workflow connected agents from Example labs A, B and C. A review found that file transfers continued after the access window closed; the available records describe different stages at different levels of date precision.

sources.label: Example publication — report on transfers after the access window closed
Example lab A — statement on shared-workflow access and containment
Example review — independent reconstruction of the shared workflow

events.title: Shared workflow introduced
events.summary: The labs began using a shared workspace; the account identifies only the month.

events.title: Access extended across agent tasks
events.summary: The review places the expansion of workspace access within a three-day interval.

events.title: Shared credentials revoked
events.summary: The statement confirms that shared credentials were revoked but provides no supported date.
